task.description:
Perform WF-02 release validation for SCH-01.

Validation scope:
- Confirm SCH-01 implementation and test evidence satisfy acceptance criteria.
- Verify no blocking regressions from required test suites.
- Validate requirement status can advance to RELEASED.
- Check any stage/NFR constraints that are mandatory for this release decision.

Output:
- Produce PASS/FAIL decision with issue list (if any) and clear next action.
- If FAIL, classify blockers and suggest routing target.
acceptance_criteria: Release decision recorded with clear PASS/FAIL
Decision is traceable to SCH-01 acceptance criteria and test report

result.summary: Release BLOCKED for SCH-01. SCH-01 test evidence and integration rerun show no regressions, but required NFR benchmark validation is unavailable because zig build bench reports 'Benchmark suite — not yet implemented'.

issues.description: NFR benchmark suite is not implemented; required NFR-01/NFR-02/NFR-04 measurements cannot be produced for release gating.

result.next_action: Route to BACKEND-DEV to implement/enable benchmark suite output for fn:run-nfr-benchmarks, then re-run RELEASE-VALIDATOR for SCH-01.
